scope: Local Apple silicon development change atop baseCommit, identified by source/output hashes. Unsigned .app only; no new DMG or release asset. Four affected native suites passed on this exact package. Fresh full hosted qualification is still required; the earlier 2e720b7 fourteen-suite milestone does not qualify this changed app.

package.method: All 39 local build files were independently extracted from app.asar with @electron/asar and compared byte for byte by SHA-256. ASAR and native-script hashes were checked before and after each suite.

checks: Chat exposes Auto, connection default and discovered models; connection setup remains in Settings.
all annotation tools, zoom alignment, selected image crops, every-page review, and checked edits applied to a real PDF.
Undo and restoring a saved version restore the corresponding source and rebuild the PDF.
version comparison, old-note navigation and missing-fact questions without source changes.
cancellation keeps the original; a completed AI draft cannot overwrite newer manual edits.
outside file changes invalidate an in-flight AI result without replacing editor text.
the final disk check protects outside edits even without a watcher event.
damaged history rejects Save before source, metadata or the prior history archive changes.
Save As forks chat/history independently; source export includes matching history without AI credentials.
autosave waits during AI work and resumes with retained manual edits after cancellation.
clean PDF export excludes annotations; closing during a request restores an actionable conversation without changing source.
a real PDF text edit uses one Fast model call, no input images, and compile-only History status.
closing during Save As waits for the transaction and recovers the newly saved project identity.
actionable AI errors, retry draft, persistent chat/notes/history, recovery, compact controls and no renderer errors.
autosave defaults off, untitled projects keep recovery without folder prompts.
drag/keyboard/reset, minimum sizes, usable controls, sidebar toggle and editor undo.
source and chat autosave, typing during a save remains dirty and saves next.
external edits pause autosave; background IPC refuses conflicts without an overwrite dialog.
failed writes roll back and pause; explicit Save resumes autosave.
choosing another project suspends autosave through the native file dialog.
close waits for autosave; source, disabled recovery and preferences survive restart. No renderer errors.
failed startup exposes real before/attempted/current copies; default preserves outside edit; compact controls work in both themes; reload releases abandoned review
stale review changes no files; refreshed choices preserve newer outside edit and editor/conversation drafts; chosen files reopen and compile
binary/history choices, source deletion and new asset apply exactly; selected source, asset and conversation round-trip in ZIP export
normal project menu supports damaged backups; native close waits for Apply; reopening uses chosen project; another project’s unsaved source is retained without overwriting its folder
reload during Apply waits and opens chosen files/history; completed copies remain accessible after the review is closed
dismissing a failed partial Apply re-enters recovery; an old editor buffer cannot erase the pending choices
a newer project format is rejected visibly; both folders and the current PDF remain unchanged.
malformed ZIP reports a useful error and leaves the current project unchanged.
destination cancellation retains the selection; Cancel leaves no extracted files.
selected entry compiles real relative inputs; assets survive and original files remain unchanged.
source ZIP round-trip retains draft and immutable PDF history with a fresh identity.
folder open retains the selected entry and offers main-file choice. No renderer errors.
busy import stays visible on Escape; closing waits and recovers the imported project.

performance.scope: Real ProjectStore and WorkspaceStore operations with synthetic one-file resumes and new isolated profiles; no renderer, compiler, network or AI requests.
limits: Each version adds a distinct TeX comment and reuses the same previously compiled PDF. These are unverified storage fixtures, not new compiler or AI acceptance.
OS caches are not purged. Ordered stages reuse files; memory can remain allocated between cases in this Node process.
Save includes regenerating the history archive. Separate archive and save stages overlap in work and must not be added or subtracted as independent components.
10 ms timer lateness measures observed Node event-loop stalls, not renderer frame rate. RSS sampling can miss synchronous peaks; values exclude Electron and child processes.
Small sample sets are descriptive observations, not population p95, worst-case limits or a supported-device memory budget.
performance.scheduling: No local native tests, packaging or other Folio benchmark ran concurrently with these measurements. Normal desktop work continued. OS caches were not purged.

failureObservations.observation: The first full source-test attempt aborted in the existing pack-download test process with a Node InternalCallbackScope execution_async_id assertion. Its cause has not been established. The isolated 16 pack-download tests and subsequent complete 244-test suite pass.
The first package attempt could not resolve github.com under restricted networking. The final permitted network run completed. This is not an application crash.

Exploratory all-deflated and level-1 worker benchmarks reduced timer lateness but did not improve complete save time. Final paired results use stored PDF bytes, compressed JSON and the near-limit fully-deflated fallback; earlier benchmark/package runs are not substituted for the final data.
